component: Muse vision position-table sampling order (non-square patch grids)

corroborating_reference.role: Independent statement of the same fix (grid_thw[:, [0, 2, 1]]); it also notes that MuseSparkVisionPatchEmbedder already used this order. Not an implementation source.

modifications: PatchEmbedder._position_embeddings samples the learned table as a (w, h) grid for an (h, w) patch grid, matching the trained reference's grid_sample over meshgrid(pos_h, pos_w, indexing="xy"). One line, same as upstream, with the loop variables renamed for clarity.
The CPU tower comparison against Transformers 5.17 applies the #50847 order to the reference, since 5.17 still has the (h, w) order.
validation: New CPU tests: non-square grids match an independent F.grid_sample(meshgrid xy, bilinear, zeros, align_corners=False) oracle at 2e-6; match the fixed Transformers helper call; square grids keep the pre-fix values; the old order differs by > 0.1 on a 4x6 grid. All three fail on the pre-fix source.
All tests/test_muse*.py CPU tests pass (hf_original excluded).
impact: Every non-square image on the native Muse vision route was mis-positioned before this fix. Prior Muse vision GPU evidence (docs/research/muse-vision-serving-20261103) was produced with the old order and is stale for non-square images. The route was and remains unqualified.
not_covered: The pinned mlx-vlm candidate route (src/mlx2/adapters/muse_glimmer_vision_candidate.py) loads mlx_vlm/models/muse_glimmer from an external source tree at 8a5e704e. That pin predates #2746, so it is expected to carry the old order, but this was not verified: the source tree is not on disk.
